bio_en: Aristakes Zorian, known as Karo (Aris), was born in 1871 in Tsghna in Goghtn near Agulis; decisive and independent, he regarded retreat before the enemy as mortal shame. When comrades fled the 1892 cholera and support dried up in 1893, he collected funds and materials under police noses and revived the party's workshop. Forced underground in 1894, he narrowly escaped arrest in Moscow under a false passport in 1895 and in 1896 was transporting arms. He fell at Khanasor in July 1897, covering the retreat of the victorious force with Astvatsatur Mirzayan (Kretatsi); his love for the teacher Maro is told in 'Karo and Maro'.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Years 1871-1897 from the title. Not to be confused with Karo (Hambardzum Aghajanian) or Karo Sasuni.
